about: GREYS retail wine counter cards for GREYS Studio. Batch 1 (2026-11-15): every wine in the Square Retail Wine category (plus RTL-named bottles) that sold 2026-09-02 to 2026-11-15 and is still a retail item. Researched producer, region, grape and tasting notes. type picks the badge glass (red, white, rose, orange, sparkling, sparkling-rose, dessert, port); line is the rust line under the band. Rebuild with tools/cheese-cards (node build.js --wine); see its README.

skipped.why: Cordoni Vol + Vine: no grape or style information anywhere
Vin de Savoie: producer and color unknown from Square (UPC 3279981011221)
Benguela Cove (sold as RTL Cuvée 58): now renamed Moody Lagoon, in the Wine (pour) category and off at Memphis

cards.name: Joyce Gamay Noir
cards.title: Gamay Noir
cards.desc: Russell Joyce's whole-cluster Gamay from a cool, windy corner of Monterey. Light and juicy, with sour cherry, cranberry, strawberry and herbs.

cards.name: Clouston Sauvignon Blanc
cards.title: Sauvignon Blanc
cards.desc: Fermented in concrete eggs and old French oak for a rounder, creamier Kiwi Sauvignon. Fresh herbs, gooseberry, passionfruit and lime.

cards.name: Cordoni Maser Sauvignon Vert
cards.title: Sauvignon Vert
cards.desc: From a small family winery in the green hills of Montone, Umbria. The Cordonis grow their own grapes and make just a handful of artisan wines.

cards.name: Côte de Brouilly
cards.title: Côte de Brouilly
cards.desc: One of Beaujolais' ten crus, from the steep slopes of Mont Brouilly and its hard blue stone. Dark berries, a little pepper and a mineral edge.

cards.name: Wineslut Red
cards.title: Wineslut Red
cards.desc: From Master of Wine Amy Christine, co-owner of Holus Bolus in Santa Barbara County. A California red built on Malbec and Mourvèdre.

cards.name: Mondeuse
cards.title: Mondeuse
cards.desc: Savoie's native red grape: light on its feet, with dark berries, violets and a peppery kick. A natural with Beaufort and other Alpine cheeses.

cards.name: Picpoul de Pinet
cards.title: Picpoul de Pinet
cards.desc: Grown around the Étang de Thau, a saltwater lagoon famous for its oysters. Zesty lemon, green apple and a salty snap. The name means “lip stinger.”

cards.name: Isabella Bobal
cards.title: Bobal
cards.origin: Ribera del Júcar, Castilla-La Mancha, Spain
cards.desc: Spain's under-the-radar native red, grown inland between Valencia and La Mancha. Deep color with black cherry, plum and a little spice.

cards.name: Thaya Sylvaner
cards.title: Sylvaner
cards.desc: From the Thaya winery near Znojmo, by the Dyje (Thaya) River and the Austrian border. Crisp and herbal, with green apple and pear.

cards.name: The Raincatcher
cards.title: The Raincatcher
cards.grape: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Merlot
cards.desc: A Cabernet-led Bordeaux blend from the cool lower slopes of the Helderberg, by Longridge winemaker Jasper Raats. Red berries, cherry and bay leaf.

cards.name: Longridge Pinotage
cards.title: Pinotage
cards.desc: South Africa's own grape, a 1925 cross of Pinot Noir and Cinsault, made here in an elegant style. Raspberry, cedar and a whiff of rosemary.

cards.name: RR Pinot Gris
cards.title: Pinot Gris
cards.desc: From Ridgecrest, the first vineyard on Oregon's Ribbon Ridge, planted by Harry Peterson-Nedry in 1980. Pear, peach and citrus with crisp acidity.

cards.name: Txakoli Malda
cards.title: Txakoli
cards.desc: The Basque coast's own white: lighter in alcohol, with a gentle spritz. Citrus, stone fruit and a salty, mineral snap. Pour it from up high.

cards.name: Unico Zelo Truffle Hound
cards.title: Truffle Hound
cards.origin: Clare Valley & Adelaide Hills, South Australia
cards.desc: An Aussie take on Piedmont's grapes, named for Barolo's truffle hunters and their dogs. Cherry, herbs and a savory, amaro-like finish.

cards.name: Jaffurs Pinot Noir
cards.title: Pinot Noir
cards.desc: Jaffurs is best known for Rhône-style wines; this is their Santa Barbara County Pinot. Cherry, sage and orange peel over black tea and spice.

cards.name: Château du Mayne Sauternes
cards.title: Sauternes
cards.desc: Bordeaux's famous sweet wine, from grapes touched by noble rot. Honey, apricot and orange marmalade. Classic with blue cheese, especially Roquefort.

cards.name: Opstal Cinsault
cards.title: Cinsault
cards.desc: From a seventh-generation family estate in the Slanghoek Valley. Light and juicy, somewhere between a rosé and a red. Serve it a little cool.

cards.name: Hervé Dubois Grand Cru Champagne
cards.title: Hervé Dubois
cards.origin: Avize, Côte des Blancs, Champagne, France
cards.desc: Grower Champagne from a family estate in Avize, in the Côte des Blancs, founded in 1920. All Grand Cru Chardonnay: chalky, mineral and lightly toasty.

cards.name: Laberinto País
cards.title: País
cards.desc: País came to Chile with Spanish missionaries in the 1500s. Rafael Tirado makes it light and lively: blood orange, red cherry and herbs.

cards.name: Galerna Garnacha
cards.title: Garnacha
cards.desc: Organic, unoaked Garnacha from central Spain. Ripe cherry and red berries with a peppery, violet-scented finish. Easy with charcuterie.

cards.name: Kopke 10 Year Tawny Port
cards.title: 10 Year Tawny
cards.grape: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca
cards.desc: From Kopke, the oldest Port house, founded in 1638. Aged in oak casks: dried fruit, toasted nuts, caramel and spice. Lovely with blue cheese.

cards.name: Olifantsberg Chenin Blanc
cards.title: Chenin Blanc
cards.desc: From a small family estate in Breedekloof, made by winemaker Elizma Visser. Lime, grapefruit and nectarine with a hint of honey and chamomile.

cards.name: Moutard Champagne Rosé
cards.title: Champagne Rosé
cards.origin: Buxeuil, Côte des Bar, Champagne, France
cards.line: Côte des Bar, Champagne  ·  Pinot Noir
cards.desc: A Rosé de Cuvaison: all Pinot Noir, given a short soak on the skins for its color. Rose petal, crushed red berries and kirsch.

cards.name: Cordoni Maser Pinot Nero
cards.title: Pinot Nero
cards.desc: Pinot Noir (Pinot Nero in Italian) from the Cordoni family's small estate in Montone, Umbria, where they grow their own grapes.

cards.name: Cordoni Maser Chardonnay
cards.title: Chardonnay
cards.desc: Estate-grown Chardonnay from the Cordoni family, who make wine in the hills of Umbria and keep a second home in Knoxville, Tennessee.

cards.name: La Caña Albariño
cards.title: Albariño
cards.desc: From Jorge Ordóñez, who helped introduce Albariño to America. Old vines in Rías Baixas give stone fruit, citrus and pear with a salty finish.
